claim: Simon Green: OU connection first, then the official citation, which stays as written.

suggestion.to: A main-belt asteroid named after Simon Green, Emeritus Professor at the Open University. Its official naming citation reads: “Simon F. Green (b. 1959) has carried out observations of minor planets and transneptunian objects for over 20 years, starting with the use of the IRAS satellite to detect fast-moving objects.” The shape model of this object is awaiting further study - and it may or may not be accurately represented in this visualisation.
